text:
priya: Quick sync — BlueCrest private deployment is scheduled for next Wed 04:00 PT. Need final owners for networking, air-gap image sync, certs, and KMS. We have a go/no-go on Friday 17:00 PT. Who owns peering + firewall rules?

omar: I can own peering + firewall. I'll loop in @netops to confirm egress NAT and static IP allocations.

netops: FYI we need the exact CIDR ranges and a routing plan (static vs BGP). Also confirm whether they require source/destination checks disabled.

priya: CIDR: `10.110.0.0/16`. Egress static IPs: `54.23.11.4`, `54.23.11.5`, `54.23.11.6`. Customer is using static routes (no BGP). I'll attach the customer's diagram to the ticket.

taylor: Air-gap note: we need to pre-stage signed images + the license bundle on their appliance. @eng-infra should assemble the installer tar. Target: Thu EOD.

kevin: I can do image signing. Need the image list and runtime versions. priya, can you confirm?

priya: Model-serving image: `rwinf/serve:2.9.1`, runtime: `rwinf/runtime:1.14`. Also include `rwinf/sidecar-metrics:0.6.3`. I'll DM the full manifest.

sasha: Security checklist: KMS cross-account grant, HSM endpoint validation, control-plane TLS certs, and audit log forwarding. @security please advise on cert rotation and audit retention.

security: Recommend initial cert rotation interval of 90 days for rollout, then move to 30 days after stability. We need customer HSM endpoint + IAM principal for cross-account KMS grants. Also require SOC2 attestation copy.

omar: For KMS they plan to use their AWS KMS. @cs can you confirm the contact and if they can create the grant?

cs: I'll schedule a call with Marta (BlueCrest infra) for tomorrow 10:00 PT and send a preflight checklist. Also flag: BlueCrest requests SOC2 docs and an export-control questionnaire filled out.

priya: Blocker: air-gap pretest showed very slow rsync over their VPN. @eng-oncall any suggestions to speed up or alternative transfer methods?

eng-oncall: Try increasing MTU to 9000 and using parallel rsync threads. Example command for canary:

```
rsync -av --inplace --progress --partial --no-compress --bwlimit=0 --rsh="ssh -T -o Compression=no" --copy-unsafe-links -e "ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -i /path/key" /local/images/ user@edge:/opt/staging/ --files-from=<(find /local/images -maxdepth 1 -type f | head -n 500)
```

Start with a 500MB canary, check transfer time. If still bad, fallback to signed USB shipment (customer agreed as last resort).

omar: I'll run the canary tonight at ~23:00 PT and post logs here. If canary fails, we proceed with USB fallback.

kevin: Also need to confirm offline secrets process: we'll wrap secrets with KMS + sealed-secrets. @security can you confirm the offline unwrap flow?

security: Confirmed. We'll produce the step-by-step doc and attach it to the ticket after our sync.

priya: Owners recap: networking = @omar, air-gap images = @taylor/@kevin, security = @sasha (and @security), CS = @cs. Milestone: Fri 17:00 PT = go/no-go. Any objections?

taylor: No objections, sounds good :thumbsup:

omar: No objections. I'll post the peering request template by EOD.

priya: Thanks everyone — I'll update the rollout tracker and ping after the canary. :eyes:
